title: Moss Slipway
description: A D-flat improvisation begins halfway into a thought. Chromatic neighbours soften the melody before its borrowed descending phrase finally appears. A brief flourish moves from one hand to the other; the return is reduced to a few chord tops and a warm major ninth.
technical_note: Give the late entries and chromatic approaches a natural spoken shape. Match the tone of the two alternating semiquaver flourishes while keeping the resting hand silent. Project the top line of the final chords without thickening the sound.

performance.note: Authored breathing, changing dialogue and independent voicing; no random timing.

composition_time_source: Recorded when the first score was saved.

audio_reverb.description: Subtle warm room; preserve the clarity of moving voices.
